notes: Contradicts lessons.md claim that 'NUTS with diagonal IMM achieves PASS on the standard 2-D formulation'. Empirically FAILs at all warmup budgets tested (1k, 3k, 10k). Budget-invariant geometry failure: the funnel's position-dependent curvature prevents any fixed step size from traversing both neck and body. See also failed__nuts__window_adaptation_diag_imm__ta099.json for the ta=0.99 experiment.
workflow: Ran NUTS + window_adaptation_diag_imm at three warmup budgets (1k, 3k, 10k). All FAIL. The diagnostic pattern confirms a budget-invariant geometry blocker: step_size converges to ~0.077-0.165 (global mean), which works in the funnel BODY (large-v, high-x-variance region) but causes divergences in the NECK (small-v, tiny-x-variance). With more warmup, the bias (max_z) INCREASES because the adapted step_size further optimises for the wide region: z=2.34 at 1k warmup, z=3.34 at 3k, z=6.03 at 10k. This is budget-invariant in the same way as the MCLMC family failures on this model. Run date: 2026-07-29.
